question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name, COUNT(*) as total_wins
FROM (
    SELECT home_team_api_id as team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal FROM Match
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id as team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal FROM Match
) AS all_teams
JOIN Team t ON all_teams.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE all_teams.team_api_id IS NOT NULL
  AND all_teams.team_api_id != 0
  AND all_teams.home_team_goal > all_teams.away_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 10
